label: def:antiderivative
title: Antiderivative
statement: A function $F : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is an \emph{antiderivative} of $f$ on $(a,b)$ if for every $x \in (a,b)$, $F$ has derivative $f(x)$ at $x$ (in the sense of \texttt{HasDerivAt}). In the Lean formalization this is \texttt{IsAntiderivativeOn F f a b}, defined as $\forall x \in (a,b),\; \texttt{HasDerivAt}\; F\; (f\; x)\; x$.
